title.en: christmas market on albert square, with the ferris wheel.
title.de: weihnachtsmarkt am albert square, mit riesenrad.
title.tr: albert square'de noel pazarı, dönme dolapla.

line.en: the christmas market is open on albert square and the big ferris wheel is back. go in the early afternoon, before the evening crowd.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt ist auf dem albert square offen, und das große riesenrad ist wieder da. am frühen nachmittag hingehen, vor dem abendtrubel.
line.tr: noel pazarı albert square'de açık ve büyük dönme dolap geri döndü. öğleden sonra, akşam kalabalığından önce gidin.

sparks.why: Manchester Christmas Markets 2026 open from 6 Nov, Albert Square runs to 3 Jan 2027 with the Ferris wheel back (Visit Manchester; Brit Brief).
